name: dsers-dropshipping
description: A dropshipping skill from DSers for dropshippers: check whether each product really makes a profit, handle supplier and order problems such as stockouts, late parcels, refunds, and disputes, clean up imported supplier listings, and check a dropship store before launch. Works on its own. Connect DSers MCP, the official MCP server from DSers for AI-powered dropshipping automation, to source and import products from AliExpress, 1688, and Alibaba.com, connect them to your store, manage suppliers and orders, automate fulfillment, and sync tracking — all in one conversation.
